title: Deflect the King to Win the Queen #1 ♛
subtitle: Bxf7+ deflects the Black King and wins the d8 Queen!
tacticalGoal: Play Bxf7+ to deflect the King and capture the Queen.
learningSummary: 1. Bxf7+ checked Black's King and lured it to f7. With the King deflected from defending d8, White captured 2. Qxd8.
keyTakeaway: Sacrificing a minor piece to deflect the king away from defending heavy pieces wins overwhelming material.

stepExplanations.explanation: White plays Bxf7+, capturing the enemy P on f7!
Black plays Kxf7, capturing the enemy B on f7!
